title: Air Force going-public plan called off

tellings.quote: he said 2009 to 2010, he was part of an air force going public plan that was called off by a twostar general.

plain: A witness who goes by the online name UAPGerb, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025, says a man named Ed told him he had been part of a US Air Force plan, around 2009 to 2010, to go public about UFOs. According to UAPGerb, a two-star general, a senior officer, called the plan off. If true, it would mean the military came close to an official announcement and then pulled back.
